LOCAL HAPPENINGS
Charles White Park Reimagined in Altadena
Los Angeles County broke ground October 3 on a reimagined Charles White Park in Altadena. Plans bring together
an inclusive playground designed by Disney Imagineers, a splash pad, lighted pickleball courts, and a new
recreation center. Native shade trees, accessible walkways, a demonstration garden, and public art will give visitors
more ways to play, gather, and explore the five-acre park. If you live in 93536, this gives you a future county outing to
look forward to, with play areas, gardens, and recreation in Altadena.

narration.title: Home Values
narration.text: In Lancaster and Quartz Hill, 93536, home prices are down 6% from a year ago, so buyers should negotiate carefully.

narration.title: Realtor Introduction
narration.text: colby test test of Test Realtor Group serves Lancaster and Quartz Hill and brings you this October market update with the latest pricing, inventory, and sales data for your neighborhood.

narration.title: Median sale prices
narration.text: The median sale price is now $520K, down 6% from a year ago and up 3.9% from five years ago. For buyers, that makes budgets easier to test against recently completed sales.

narration.title: Price per square foot
narration.text: Price per square foot is now $257, down 2.1% from a year ago. Buyers comparing homes of similar size and condition can use this to judge whether a price is reasonable.

narration.title: Available homes
narration.text: There are 492 homes available now, down 9.9% from a year ago and down 25.1% from five years ago. Buyers have a smaller selection to choose from, so comparing options quickly matters.

narration.title: Median days on market
narration.text: The median days on market is 54, down 5.3% from a year ago. Sellers can use that figure to plan a marketing timeline, though it is not a promised sale date.

narration.title: Homes sold
narration.text: A total of 186 homes sold in the 3 months ending October, down 14.3% from a year ago. Sellers can use these completed sales as evidence when reviewing their asking price.

narration.title: Sales above, at and below asking
narration.text: Above asking was the largest sales group, more common than last year.
narration.takeaway: Sales above, at and below asking

narration.title: Local happenings
narration.text: Los Angeles County broke ground October 3 on a reimagined Charles White Park in Altadena, with an inclusive playground, splash pad, lighted pickleball courts, and a new recreation center planned for the five-acre park.

narration.title: Sale-to-list percentage
narration.text: Homes are selling for about 0.8% under their final asking price. Sellers should expect some room for negotiation, and buyers may find an opening to offer slightly below asking.

narration.title: Contact
narration.text: Buyers and sellers in Lancaster and Quartz Hill can use recent completed sales to set realistic budgets, offers, and listing prices. Call colby test test 9162128640

Plans bring together an inclusive playground designed by Disney Imagineers, a splash pad, lighted pickleball courts, and a new recreation center. Native shade trees, accessible walkways, a demonstration garden, and public art will give visitors more ways to play, gather, and explore the five-acre park. If you live in 93536, this gives you a future county outing to look forward to, with play areas, gardens, and recreation in Altadena.
